authority.releaseRule: A formal release source commit must equal the latest origin/internal commit.

recentIntegratedHistory.reason: PR #263 made explicitly unsigned, checksum-verified release artifacts the current internal policy.
PR #264 disabled implicit publishing for tagged desktop builds.
PR #265 configured the explicit generic update publisher used by packaged desktop builds.

commitDecisions.subject: feat(server): add SQLCipher database encryption
commitDecisions.reason: Rebase the SQLCipher lifecycle and native boundary onto schema 18 without importing the old database owner.

commitDecisions.subject: feat(enterprise): add E2EE private chat
commitDecisions.reason: The device-envelope implementation is not the final MLS authority and must not coexist as a second production protocol.

commitDecisions.subject: feat(server): lay PostgreSQL enterprise storage foundation
commitDecisions.reason: Reuse the lifecycle and pool contracts while regenerating migrations from the current enterprise schema.

commitDecisions.subject: feat(server): add S3 attachment object storage
commitDecisions.reason: S3 storage follows the PostgreSQL authority and must retain the current attachment ACL and compensation contracts.

commitDecisions.subject: feat(server): enforce clustered enterprise storage topology
commitDecisions.reason: The old topology couples PostgreSQL, Redis and S3 and must be split after SERVER-02 establishes database authority.

commitDecisions.subject: feat(security): gate E2EE release and approve devices
commitDecisions.reason: Preserve fail-closed approval and release gates while binding them to the final MLS protocol and current routes.

commitDecisions.subject: ci(sqlcipher): attest five-platform native assets
commitDecisions.reason: The workflow currently fails both Linux targets and has no complete five-platform release attestation.

commitDecisions.subject: feat(ui): complete security and message management surfaces
commitDecisions.reason: This is an obsolete UI merge topology; the current internal UI is authoritative and security surfaces must be re-applied behaviorally.

commitDecisions.subject: feat(server): add verified SQLite PostgreSQL importer
commitDecisions.reason: Keep read-only scanning, hashes and resumability but replace the split v3 migration and SQLCipher-coupled reader.

commitDecisions.subject: feat(security): add unified envelope key management
commitDecisions.reason: Key custody must be integrated after the final SQLCipher/native packaging boundary is fixed.

commitDecisions.subject: feat(security): pin e2ee transparency checkpoints
commitDecisions.reason: Transparency checkpoints must cover the final device directory and MLS epochs before audit.

commitDecisions.subject: feat: move enterprise core authority to PostgreSQL
commitDecisions.reason: The old promotion maps only a small core subset and omits current park, commercial, knowledge and governance tables.

commitDecisions.subject: feat: wire shared S3 and Redis infrastructure
commitDecisions.reason: Shared coordination must fail closed and follow the completed PostgreSQL authority.

commitDecisions.subject: feat: migrate verified SQLite attachments to S3
commitDecisions.reason: Attachment migration requires the current ACL, compensation and retention model.

commitDecisions.subject: feat: move enterprise registration authority to PostgreSQL
commitDecisions.reason: Registration can move only after the current identity and organization schema has a complete PostgreSQL mapper.

commitDecisions.subject: feat: add OpenMLS key package foundation
commitDecisions.reason: Retain official OpenMLS primitives while integrating them into the current approved-device and server authority.

commitDecisions.subject: feat: add OpenMLS two-device message interop
commitDecisions.reason: In-memory two-device tests are a foundation, not the production multi-device transport.

commitDecisions.subject: feat: persist encrypted OpenMLS state
commitDecisions.reason: State persistence must be replayed after the production server schema and recovery policy are fixed.

commitDecisions.subject: feat: connect OpenMLS to desktop secure storage
commitDecisions.reason: Desktop secure storage must bind to the final server capability and cannot enable a silent protocol downgrade.

commitDecisions.subject: fix: snapshot authorized directory attachments
commitDecisions.reason: The attachment snapshot belongs with the final S3 ACL and compensation implementation.

commitDecisions.subject: feat: add governed MLS ciphertext transport
commitDecisions.reason: The transport must use the completed PostgreSQL authority and final MLS group lifecycle.

commitDecisions.subject: feat: wire desktop MLS transport foundation
commitDecisions.reason: The foundation is not connected to the production composer or history writer and must be integrated behaviorally.

commitDecisions.subject: feat: add resumable MLS session orchestration
commitDecisions.reason: Session orchestration still lacks remote member commits and final multi-device semantics.

commitDecisions.subject: feat: add crash-safe MLS application outbox
commitDecisions.reason: The outbox must be mapped to the final authoritative database and tested under real restart recovery.

commitDecisions.subject: feat: retry durable MLS outbox in background
commitDecisions.reason: Retry behavior must share leases, idempotency and shutdown semantics with the final server runtime.

commitDecisions.subject: feat: add crash-safe MLS receive polling
commitDecisions.reason: Receive polling still lacks complete remote commit, revocation and malicious-server acceptance coverage.

commitDecisions.subject: merge: sync latest internal
commitDecisions.reason: This merge synchronized only an older internal head; all integration must restart from the current baseline.

commitDecisions.subject: feat(security): harden E2EE trust and prototype OpenMLS
commitDecisions.reason: Threat-model and trust invariants are valuable, but the implementation overlaps the newer MLS transport files.

commitDecisions.subject: feat(security): enforce E2EE v2 in clustered authority
commitDecisions.reason: Clustered enforcement must follow the final PostgreSQL and MLS authority instead of introducing a parallel v2 owner.

commitDecisions.subject: fix(desktop): clear tool copy timers on unmount
commitDecisions.reason: This independent one-file lifecycle fix is absent from internal and should be manually reapplied without merging the branch.

commitDecisions.subject: feat(security): establish E2EE v2 device trust foundation
commitDecisions.reason: The alternate secure_messaging owner would duplicate collaboration storage and an obsolete schema 19.

commitDecisions.subject: feat(security): expose E2EE device trust APIs
commitDecisions.reason: API behavior should be retained only through the final collaboration and MLS authority.

commitDecisions.subject: feat(security): protect E2EE device trust on desktop
commitDecisions.reason: Desktop trust UX belongs to the formal E2EE API and must not ship against the alternate server implementation.

Both origin/codex/mature-agent-safety-controls and origin/uiux-preview have zero commits ahead of origin/internal.
